## 中文

### 新增功能

- 新增商汤日日新 SenseNova 文本与生图模型支持，更新官方 API 地址与模型配置。
- 新增本地 Ollama 文本模型和实验性生图模型支持。
- 新增本地 ComfyUI 生图支持，可粘贴 API Format 工作流 JSON，并提供配置说明。
- 将文档资料与图片素材整合为统一的知识库入口；创建知识库时可选择资料类型。
- 新增本地图片素材库，支持文件夹、搜索、标签、批量移动、复制引用和正文插图。
- 新增技术卷编排，可选择一级章节、调整顺序并单独导出技术卷。
- 为标书查重与废标项检查补充结果导出能力。

### 优化与修复

- 优化知识库、图片素材卡片、批量操作、移动菜单和图片编辑弹窗的交互与视觉一致性。
- 优化技术方案与已有方案扩写的正文编辑工具栏和插入图片入口。
- 修复 SenseNova Base URL 与模型能力配置不正确的问题。
- 修复 ComfyUI 工作流输入区域布局与说明展示问题。
- 修复技术卷编排、图片选择弹窗和导出路径在暗黑模式下出现浅色背景的问题。
- 改进本地文件删除、工作区数据迁移与技术方案配置存储的安全性和兼容性。

## English

### New features

- Added SenseTime SenseNova text and image generation providers with updated official API endpoints and model configuration.
- Added support for local Ollama text models and experimental image generation models.
- Added local ComfyUI image generation with API Format workflow JSON and in-app configuration guidance.
- Unified document resources and image assets under one Knowledge Base entry, with selectable library types during creation.
- Added a local image asset library with folders, search, tags, batch move, reference copying, and insertion into document content.
- Added technical volume composition for selecting, reordering, saving, and exporting top-level chapters.
- Added result export capabilities for duplicate checking and rejection-risk checking.

### Improvements and fixes

- Refined the Knowledge Base, image cards, batch actions, move menu, and image editing dialog for a more consistent experience.
- Improved the content editing toolbar and image insertion flow in both Technical Plan and Existing Plan Expansion.
- Fixed incorrect SenseNova Base URL and model capability settings.
- Improved the ComfyUI workflow JSON editor and contextual guidance.
- Fixed light backgrounds in dark mode for technical volume composition, image selection, and exported-file paths.
- Improved the safety and compatibility of local deletion, workspace migrations, and technical plan settings storage.
